sections.text: You stand before the haunted manor. The door is slightly ajar.

options.description: Push the door open and enter

sections.text: You are in the main hall. A ghost suddenly appears and attacks you!

consequence.text: The ghost chills you to the bone, but you manage to push past it.

sections.text: You cut yourself on the broken glass, but you're inside. You find a first-aid kit on a table.

consequence.text: You bandage your cuts and feel slightly better.

sections.text: You defeated the ghost and found the hidden treasure in the parlour. You win!
You trip on the stairs and fall back down into the ghost's arms. Game over.
